scope: owner-authorized read-only diagnosis of the beta node and the owner phone after two failed beta.22 attempts and one supervised attempt
interpretation: The node, window budget and control path are healthy. On Wi-Fi no handshake traffic reached the node. On mobile data one handshake request reached the node and a response was sent, but no handshake completed and no further packets arrived. The phone-side or carrier-side cause is not established. The 20 s capture can miss the 25 s keepalive interval, so it is not proof that the phone is silent.
not_established: whether the node response reaches the phone
why the phone stops after the first exchange
whether the Wi-Fi block is the router or the ISP
